entities.name: Robert Pražák
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert Pražák was a Czech gymnast. He competed for Czechoslovakia at the 1920 Summer Olympics and the 1924 Summer Olympics, winning three silver medals. He was also a member of the Gold-medal-winning Bohemian team at the 1913 World Championships.
